verified.method: read-only eth_call/eth_getCode/eth_getStorageAt against https://rpc.quai.network/cyprus1 (the /cyprus1 path suffix is required; the bare host answers eth_chainId but fails every eth_call)
verified.signingInitialized: call reverts — signed orders are NOT live on mainnet
verified.eip712Domain: call reverts — signed orders not initialized
verified.ownershipNote: owner() is a plain EOA (no code on-chain), NOT the TimelockController recorded in the `timelock` field. That timelock IS deployed and live at 0x005271b466765176a8a79b3f9A621c40abA1bffC with getMinDelay() = 172800 (48h), but the proxy was never handed over to it (acceptOwnership() not run) and the owner EOA does not even hold PROPOSER_ROLE on it. The live mainnet upgrade is therefore a DIRECT single-EOA upgrade with no timelock delay — see docs/SIGNED_ORDERS_AUDIT_BRIEF.md R12.
verified.upgradeNote: Owner key IS present in contracts/.env as CYPRUS1_PK, so `npm run upgrade -- --network cyprus1` would upgrade live production. It is deliberately NOT run without explicit approval; it also cannot complete a usable upgrade while ORDER_SIGNER_ADDRESS is unset (paySignedOrder would reject every payment).
